key_insight: Clinical Consensus Selection (CCS) improves radiology report generation by selecting the candidate with the highest clinical consensus rather than relying on default decoding.
clinical_relevance: The methodology enhances report quality in radiology by leveraging multimodal decision-making at inference time.
method: CCS samples multiple candidate reports during inference.
It uses a clinical consensus measure from both text and image-based utilities.
The framework is decoder-agnostic, suitable for various radiology MLLMs.
evidence_signal: Experimental results show that CCS consistently outperforms single-path decoding and generic baselines across multiple datasets.
watch_item: Further research is needed to explore the full potential of CCS in diverse clinical settings.
paper_title: CCS: Clinical Consensus Selection for Radiology Report Generation
